subject: [PATCH v2 1/3] NFS: don't let delegated c/mtime stamps go backward

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch prevents delegated c/mtime stamps from going backward by ensuring that the client's coarse clock does not trail behind the server's fine-grained ctime cached from an OPEN or SETATTR reply. When a delegated stamp is not after the cached ctime, it uses the cached ctime + 1ns instead. This fix addresses an issue where the c/mtime reported by the client while holding a delegation changes after DELEGRETURN, causing problems with file attributes. The patch modifies the nfs_fattr_fixup_delegated function to use a new helper function, nfs_delegated_stamp, which computes the stamp before storing it, ensuring that lockless readers do not see the trailing coarse time.
